brief.purpose: A local-first AI product-interface studio for designers, frontend developers, and independent builders; it turns a natural-language brief plus a design system into editable, runnable React projects with live preview, precise iteration, and version history
brief.concept: An abstract transformation from rough intent into structured interface: two or three modular planes or frames converge into one resolved canvas or portal, expressing draft to system to working product. Avoid document sheets, magic sparkles, stars, robots, chat bubbles, code brackets, cursors, and letterforms
brief.style: Calm confidence, design-tool precision, editorial restraint, contemporary and professional; bold silhouette with at most three primary shapes, instantly legible at 16 px, no text and no decorative micro-detail
brief.palette: deep spruce #145C52, warm mineral white #F3EFE6, carbon #171A18, one restrained signal accent in yellow-green #B7D85C

candidates.direction: Bold geometric silhouette with memorable negative space and the fewest possible shapes.
candidates.prompt: App: Draftly. Purpose: A local-first AI product-interface studio for designers, frontend developers, and independent builders; it turns a natural-language brief plus a design system into editable, runnable React projects with live preview, precise iteration, and version history. Core symbol: An abstract transformation from rough intent into structured interface: two or three modular planes or frames converge into one resolved canvas or portal, expressing draft to system to working product. Avoid document sheets, magic sparkles, stars, robots, chat bubbles, code brackets, cursors, and letterforms. Visual style: Calm confidence, design-tool precision, editorial restraint, contemporary and professional; bold silhouette with at most three primary shapes, instantly legible at 16 px, no text and no decorative micro-detail. Palette: deep spruce #145C52, warm mineral white #F3EFE6, carbon #171A18, one restrained signal accent in yellow-green #B7D85C. Create a distinctive, original product icon with simple geometry, excellent silhouette, clear hierarchy, no letters, no words, no watermark, no device mockup, and no UI screenshot. Candidate direction 1: Bold geometric silhouette with memorable negative space and the fewest possible shapes. Render only one standalone brand symbol, centered and front-facing, with no enclosing app tile and no cast shadow. Keep all visible artwork within the central 72 percent of a square canvas. The entire background, including every edge and corner, must be one perfectly uniform flat chroma color #FF00FF. Do not use that chroma color inside the icon.
